evidence.purpose: Consent, human-review, prohibited-use, and release boundary.
Implemented retention scope and documented deletion limitations.
Loopback API inputs, exclusions, and trust boundary.
Authorized-device, consent, format, and session contract.
Enrollment, HMAC authentication, revocation, and ingestion behavior.
Bounded buffering, backpressure, discard, and reconnect behavior.
Measured live-path evidence and explicit measurement exclusions.
Held-out acoustic results and limits on empirical claims.
Executable local authentication, revocation, and stream intake.
Executable bounded queue, explicit discard, and reconnect policy.
Checked-in A10.3 latency and reliability measurement receipt.
Automated checks for local API access and input exclusions.
Automated authentication, replay, revocation, and audio-retention checks.

findings.title: Measured local live-path regression
findings.conclusion: The checked-in A10.3 run reconciles delivery, retry, backpressure, windows, and one local-alert timing probe, but it is an accelerated in-process regression only.

findings.title: No production live-device path
findings.conclusion: The repository has no microphone or driver capture adapter, production network transport, background service supervision, or approved live model orchestration.
findings.required_action: Implement and independently test the intended hardware capture, transport, service lifecycle, and approved model path in the target environment.

findings.title: Performance evidence is not field representative
findings.conclusion: The latency report excludes real hardware, network conditions, production inference, soak behavior, and statistically stable tail latency.
findings.required_action: Run representative hardware, concurrency, failure-recovery, soak, and end-to-end latency tests with predeclared acceptance thresholds.

findings.title: No notification or reviewer operations
findings.conclusion: Alerts remain local candidates; reviewer identity, assignment, disposition, delivery, escalation, and external action are deliberately not implemented or authorized.
findings.required_action: Design, approve, and test a separately controlled human-review and notification workflow with authentication, audit, escalation, and fail-safe behavior.

findings.title: No production operations package
findings.conclusion: The prototype does not provide production observability, service-level objectives, incident response, disaster recovery, signed releases, or a supported deployment runbook.
findings.required_action: Create and approve operational monitoring, incident response, recovery, release-signing, rollback, ownership, and support procedures.

findings.title: Detection evidence is insufficient for deployment
findings.conclusion: The small balanced acoustic evaluation is not representative of deployment prevalence, environments, speech, fairness, real incidents, or alert effectiveness.
findings.required_action: Complete independent representative validation, calibration, subgroup analysis, failure analysis, and human-factors testing before setting production thresholds.

findings.title: Consent and least-scope gates are explicit
findings.conclusion: The contracts distinguish denied, withdrawn, acoustic-only, and speech-authorized processing and require current consent at processing boundaries.

findings.title: Live PCM is bounded and memory-only
findings.conclusion: The live ingestion, rolling-window, and resilience layers bound audio in memory and require explicit delivery or zeroing and discard; they do not persist PCM.

findings.title: Final outputs are privacy minimized
findings.conclusion: Final reports omit raw audio, transcript text, recipients, credentials, proofs, and absolute local paths while retaining reviewable evidence and integrity metadata.

findings.title: Data lifecycle coverage is incomplete
findings.conclusion: Retention cleanup is manual and limited to verified final bundles; it is not secure erasure and does not cover raw recordings, intermediate speech text, backups, exports, or external copies.
findings.required_action: Implement policy-owned inventory, retention, legal hold, deletion verification, backup handling, and secure disposal across every data class and copy.

findings.title: Organizational privacy approval is absent
findings.conclusion: Software validation cannot establish lawful recording authority, authentic consent, notice, purpose limitation, data-subject rights, or jurisdiction-specific compliance.
findings.required_action: Obtain documented legal, privacy, ethics, and organizational approval for the exact people, places, devices, purposes, retention, and operator workflow.

findings.title: External API exposure is constrained
findings.conclusion: The evaluation endpoint rejects non-loopback clients and accepts a local recording reference rather than uploads, URLs, recipients, transports, or notification authority.

findings.title: Device sessions are authenticated and revocable
findings.conclusion: Live intake binds expiring enrollment, one-time HMAC challenges, single-use receipts, consent, exact PCM geometry, and ordered chunks while rechecking revocation.

findings.title: Integrity and atomic persistence are implemented
findings.conclusion: Canonical hashes, strict schemas, bounded reads, and atomic writes detect accidental or unauthorized content changes, but hashes do not prove authorship or provide a signed chain of custody.

findings.title: Credential lifecycle is not production managed
findings.conclusion: HMAC possession is verified, but the credential resolver is an external integration point and the project does not provide hardware-backed storage, provisioning, rotation, recovery, or compromise response.
findings.required_action: Integrate an approved secret manager or hardware-backed keystore with authenticated provisioning, rotation, revocation, recovery, and compromise procedures.

findings.title: Host security remains outside the application
findings.conclusion: Loopback is not authentication against another local user or compromised process, and the project does not enforce operating-system identities, filesystem ACLs, encryption, process isolation, or endpoint hardening.
findings.required_action: Define and independently verify the production trust boundary, authenticated operator access, least-privilege service identity, encryption, ACLs, isolation, and host hardening.

findings.title: Independent security assurance is absent
findings.conclusion: Repository tests cover important misuse and tampering cases, but there is no independent threat model, penetration test, dependency vulnerability gate, software bill of materials, or signed release evidence.
findings.required_action: Complete an independent threat model and security assessment, add dependency and supply-chain gates, publish an SBOM, and sign approved release artifacts.
